items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: No, I didn't hear them when Hawk was doing that.

ctx.x: Oh, you didn't hear him in the -- when he had the good band.
No, I didn't hear them when Hawk was doing that.
Well, I mean, everybody says that it was -- well, Hawk always used to say the records didn't do the band justice, and I'm sure that's true.
